title: EXOTIC-CCR A001: Poisson/Weyl lifts and bounded Lean-backed Theorems E-F
description: Proposed, untagged review artifact for A001. The paper-grade analysis states the H=-iX1 deficiency-index result (infinity,infinity); the companion Lean artifact proves the bounded canonical-core Theorem E via ExoticCCR.theoremE (tag v0.1.8-theorem-e, SHA a6bb091) and, proposed and under review, the bounded Theorem F via ExoticCCR.theoremF at SHA f1fe83785add60ccc5f012b51e7576aab5627a74 (both adjoint eigenspaces ker(H-dagger -+ i) not finite-dimensional, with standard cardinal-valued lower bounds Cardinal.aleph0 <= n_+ and Cardinal.aleph0 <= n_- by measure-preserving sign-involution transport). A separate hilbertDeficiencyIndex_X1_eq_aleph0 result at that SHA gives exact aleph0 Hilbert-basis cardinality for the closed adjoint eigenspaces. standardDeficiencyIndex is Module.rank, the algebraic Hamel rank, with lower bounds only; its exact equality is not claimed. Von Neumann extension multiplicity/classification and the paper's backward-wall construction remain not Lean-covered. Prior withdrawn claims are preserved in the erratum. No new version DOI is asserted.
